lines.text: Fangyi told me to give this expansion core to you.
You deployed an AIC Factory nearby to help the Stockaders through tough times, right?
The Institute of Materials Science made a few breakthroughs in industrial technology. They should be able to help.
The city outskirts haven't recovered. Things aren't easy for the Stockaders... And we couldn't really intervene in the past either.
Thank goodness we got you as our go-between. Fangyi can finally breathe easy.
Alright, signed and delivered. I gotta head back and report to Zhuang.
Haha. I will. See you soon, Endmin.

options: And tell her to take a break!
